title: NANPA authority for NPAs 502, 505 and 508

title: Area-code-hunt shard B pass — NPAs 502, 505, 508

data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence organization-enumeration corpus are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 502, 505 and 508?
data.method: Bounded organization enumeration using current NANPA geographic admission before deterministic NPA mod 3 sharding; literal anarchist/ABC/Food Not Bombs/mutual-aid searches; locality-derived searches; first-party organization and parent/federation pages; public Linktree/social surfaces; current search; public Reddit only as discovery; and repository dedupe before canonical-ID creation.
classification_rules: Do not infer a person's political beliefs from an organizational role.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level evidence.
Historical directories are discovery seeds until current status is corroborated.
Do not merge people or organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
Inferred person-org relationships must be explicitly marked inferred; this pass promoted no inferred person-org relation.
Completed NPAs are not repeated without materially new evidence.

findings.notes: Louisville produced current Kentucky Tenant Union and Louisville Showing Up for Racial Justice / Community Defense Network mutual-aid surface; neither was relabeled anarchist.
Albuquerque/Santa Fe produced ABQ Mutual Aid, John Brown Breakfast Club, Santa Fe Mutual Aid Network and New Mexico Harm Reduction Collaborative with current public mutual-aid evidence.

Worcester produced Woo Fridge, 508 BikeLife and Implacable Books. Implacable is retained as a radical liberation-oriented infoshop and mutual-aid distribution site, not silently upgraded to self-described anarchist absent explicit current wording.
